# opnsense_caddy_status (Data Source)

Reads the current Caddy service status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_caddy_status" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Caddy service status such as `running`, `stopped`, or `disabled`.
